description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch.export module, defining functions and classes related to exporting PyTorch models, including export, save, load, draft_export, and register_dataclass, along with relevant imports and documentation.

classes.name: ExportedProgram
classes.description: Represents a traced and serialized PyTorch model ready for saving or loading.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Traces a PyTorch module with example inputs to produce an ExportedProgram representing the model's graph.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an ExportedProgram to a file or file-like object for later loading.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a previously saved ExportedProgram from a file or file-like object.

methods.name: draft_export
methods.description: Produces an ExportedProgram with potential soundness issues, along with a report of issues.

methods.name: register_dataclass
methods.description: Registers a dataclass type as valid input/output for export, enabling serialization.
